notes: Begin by dividing the deck into parts. In the Sections view you pick a Section's first slide; the Section runs until the next one starts, and the last Section runs to the end. Because membership follows the slide order, dragging a slide into a different part of the deck is all it takes to move it between Sections. Each Section can have its own Story. A title-only opening slide, like the dividers in this talk, is a real slide you add on purpose; the Section itself is just organisation. Presentations can reference a whole Section, so a talk built from Sections picks up new slides automatically.
